phase: before product baseline or parser changes
complete_value_policy: Ranges, count-percent cells, count-total cells, regression estimate-SE and estimate-CI cells are single complete targets. Where no declared whole-value metric/display contract exists, record unknown: complete_compound_contract_unsupported. Never count subcomponents as successes.
coordinate_rule: Same as native-v2: exact Word part/paragraph/offset; PDF font boxes at independent glyph indices, x edges within 1.2 points and vertical midpoint within the actual span plus 2 points. Keep ink boxes.
numeric_bound: Keep the product exponent limit of 1000. If a complete located value exceeds it, report unknown/NUMBER_LIMIT; do not lower gold values or treat them as zero.
controls: Synthetic scalar evidence is checked unchanged then changed by +1. It does not reproduce paper experiments.
comparability: Different target shapes from native-v2; report by shape and never claim an overall cross-study accuracy gain.
